_comment: One bolt on the bare table in front of the RIGHT hand: the simple case for
~/genesis_hug's HUG grasps (grasp_hug), which predict right hands only.
workcell_single.json drops its bolt at y = +0.20, in front of the left arm.
Same table and head framing (neckPitch 0.87); no bin.
Select with:  ros2 launch genesis_isaac sim.launch.py design:=genesis_wuji

cell_camera._comment: Static RGBD camera on the cell frame, in world: above and in front of the table, aimed at the bin side so it sees what the head camera hides behind the arms. Same pose for the Isaac prim (isaac_runner) and the TF (workcell_scene).
